guard: The test-only static connection binds accepted signed metadata and broker-pinned generation permissions to a copied credential snapshot. Reconnect cannot adopt caller-mutated bytes. Missing/duplicate/future metadata and legacy request fallback refuse. This does not establish shipped static or auth-callout integration.

mutations.name: credential snapshot aliases a Buffer
mutations.expectRed: native reconnect retains snapshotted credentials after caller-buffer mutation
mutations.cell: native reconnect retains snapshotted credentials after caller-buffer mutation

mutations.name: accepted reference is mutable
mutations.find: const ref = Object.freeze({ space: parts[2], owner: parts[3], actor: parts[4], uid: parts[5], generation: parts[6] });
mutations.replace: const ref = { space: parts[2], owner: parts[3], actor: parts[4], uid: parts[5], generation: parts[6] };
mutations.expectRed: the accepted reference cannot be rewritten by the caller
mutations.cell: the accepted reference cannot be rewritten by the caller

mutations.name: issued credentials retain legacy grants
mutations.find: return epRequestGrantRows(ref.space, capability, ref).map((row) => bound(row, ref));
mutations.replace: return [...epRequestGrantRows(ref.space, capability, ref), ...epRequestGrantRows(ref.space, capability, ref).map((row) => bound(row, ref))];
mutations.expectRed: new bound credentials have no legacy request fallback
mutations.cell: new bound credentials have no legacy request fallback

mutations.name: duplicate issued metadata is accepted
mutations.expectRed: duplicate issued metadata cannot establish a static binding
mutations.cell: duplicate issued metadata cannot establish a static binding

mutations.name: future metadata versions are accepted
mutations.expectRed: future issued metadata cannot establish a static binding
mutations.cell: future issued metadata cannot establish a static binding

mutations.name: generation grants are widened to a wildcard
mutations.find: return epRequestGrantRows(ref.space, capability, ref).map((row) => bound(row, ref));
mutations.replace: return epRequestGrantRows(ref.space, capability, ref).map((row) => bound(row, ref).replace(`.${ref.generation}.`, ".*."));
mutations.expectRed: accepted static credentials bind their signed generation to durable issued evidence
mutations.cell: accepted static credentials bind their signed generation to durable issued evidence

mutations.name: unsupported journal capability is accepted
mutations.find: if (capability.journal) throw new Error("journal capabilities are unsupported by this prototype");
mutations.expectRed: the prototype refuses journal capabilities instead of adding a partial rail
mutations.cell: the prototype refuses journal capabilities instead of adding a partial rail

mutations.name: discovery accepts more than one bound generation
mutations.expectRed: discovery refuses ambiguous or unbindable grant rows
mutations.cell: discovery refuses ambiguous or unbindable grant rows

mutations.name: discovery stops validating the parsed reference
mutations.expectRed: discovery refuses ambiguous or unbindable grant rows
mutations.cell: discovery refuses ambiguous or unbindable grant rows

mutations.name: discovery accepts rows from another space
mutations.expectRed: discovery refuses ambiguous or unbindable grant rows
mutations.cell: discovery refuses ambiguous or unbindable grant rows

mutations.name: discovery reads the generation from the wrong subject position
mutations.expectRed: the client discovers its accepted generation from the server, not from its own credentials
mutations.cell: the client discovers its accepted generation from the server, not from its own credentials

mutations.name: a versioned arrival is read as legacy
mutations.expectRed: an endpoint serving both rails names the refusal for an unbound arrival
mutations.cell: an endpoint serving both rails names the refusal for an unbound arrival

mutations.name: a malformed binding falls through to the legacy refusal
mutations.find: evidenceKey(ref); // a malformed binding on the versioned rail is a refusal, never a legacy arrival
mutations.replace: if (!/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(generation)) return Object.freeze({ kind: "legacy" as const, reason: UNBOUND_REFUSAL });
mutations.expectRed: a malformed binding on the versioned rail is refused rather than read as legacy
mutations.cell: a malformed binding on the versioned rail is refused rather than read as legacy

mutations.name: arrivals from another space are admitted
mutations.expectRed: a malformed binding on the versioned rail is refused rather than read as legacy
mutations.cell: a malformed binding on the versioned rail is refused rather than read as legacy

mutations.name: the generation is placed at a mode-dependent offset
mutations.expectRed: the generation sits at one offset from the tail for every rail mode
mutations.cell: the generation sits at one offset from the tail for every rail mode
